confidence_notes: Pai has no Numbeo city series, so meal and coffee estimates are anchored to current Thailand-wide prices with a modest tourism-town adjustment. Local nightlife guides give rough beer and cocktail ranges; wine evidence is sparse, so its estimate follows the higher local cocktail/beer relationship and limited reported wine range. Accommodation prices are holistic estimates with substantial seasonal uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food prices use Thailand-wide cost-of-living benchmarks adjusted for Pai's small but tourism-oriented market; accommodation uses a northern Thailand backpacker-town guesthouse basis.
